summary.text: Exodus takes place on and above the artificial plane of Rath, where the Weatherlight crew, having rescued Sisay and pieces of the Legacy, must retreat through Volrath's Stronghold to the portal off Rath.

The story follows Gerrard, who bests Greven il-Vec by sacrificing defense, and Ertai, who stands alone to open the arcane portal before his comrades return, while Crovax changes and his bloodlust threatens the ship.
Meanwhile the Skyshroud elves and the Kor, Vec and Dal tribes assault Volrath's Stronghold.
